notes.title: Patch Note Nov. 01
notes.notes: We have patched the issues of some dialogue errors, adjusted the difficulty of the first test, and the transition between scenes. Thanks for your support! We will continue support the operation of this game!

notes.title: PUPA is now a part of the Steam Visual Novel Fest and the Demo is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360703/caeaa59d8b42ad938f019f1e79426d6815a31e88.png[/img]

Hi guys! We are BlueX Proj. Studio! The Steam Visual Novel Festival has already started, and PUPA is also participating in this event. We released a Demo containing 20% of the game's content as well as a demonstration of the core gameplay. In the first three days of the Demo's release, nearly 3000 people have already added PUPA to their libraries, which is an amazing achievement and we're grateful to all of you. However, we also want to hear your voices and feedback. We've updated the demo with a new embedded QR code questionnaire to help you give feedbacks on the game's plot, gameplay and bugs. We respect every player's opinion, and we need it to make PUPA better. In the future days, we will continue to improve PUPA with the feedback from this demo and look forward to releasing the full version in 2023. In the meantime, we also have some new mechanics and ideas that we want to add in the game to make the experience even more original and fun. Feel free to enroll in PUPA Senior High at the Visual Novel Festival!

notes.title: PUPA, Our First Game
notes.notes:
Hello, we are BlueX Project, an indie game production team consisting of ten international high school students from Shanghai, and we want to tell our stories through games. And PUPA High School is our first step.

The idea of PUPA High School started on January 12th, 2022. At that time, we all finished our college applications and started reflecting on our three years of high school, and it suddenly occurred to us, what if we used a game to tell the story of those three years? Thus, we formed the BlueX Project and PUPA High School was born.


[h2]Why is it called PUPA?[/h2]
PUPA is the word that we think best describes our three years of high school; PUPA is the Latin word for chrysalis, and high school, like a chrysalis, is the last stage before we enter society and become independent. It largely shapes our values, our backgrounds, and our mindsets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360703/1f9321e7cfa1b14d1a22a2569cb180434acb5a63.png[/img]

[h2]More than just a visual novel[/h2]
PUPA High School is a 2D visual novel game. In the game, players are able to meet six characters with different personalities and experience the sweet and sour of high school life with them. The character's relationship with the player is dependent of the player's choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360703/6004456ce850e83217fb5138037cdbfa41f0d40e.png[/img]

However, life in high school can't be limited to routine and socialization, and we also wanted to make a breakthrough from traditional visual novels to provide players with richer game content. Therefore, while developing relationships with other characters, players will also have to juggle their studies and participate in extracurricular activities to expand their horizons. We strive to organically combine these expanded playstyles with the visual novel. We will also introduce these playstyles to you in subsequent announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360703/f262cce8ecd38f7f4f1ba2123a7eaf98d777ae71.png[/img]

The game will release a playthrough demo in [b]early August[/b], and the official game is expected to be sent out in [b]2023[/b], so we look forward to your playthroughs as well as feedback. If you have any suggestions or ideas, you can contact us via email or official Instagram:
